narrNote: Transition state: the longtime NARR affiliate, Colorado Agency for Recovery Residences (CARR), closed on 2025-06-30. The Behavioral Health Administration moved its recovery-residence certification contract to Ohio Recovery Housing – Colorado (ORH-C), and carrcolorado.org now serves ORH-C content. NARR's own affiliate page still carries stale CARR copy as of 2026-10-22; ORH-C is the functioning certifier to contact.
notes: Agency is Colorado's SAMHSA Single State Agency for substance use. BHA publishes team-specific phone numbers rather than one general line on its fetched pages, so agency phone is null rather than guessed. Medicaid SUD: the Department of Health Care Policy and Financing (HCPF) administers Health First Colorado SUD benefits through Regional Accountable Entities under Colorado's Section 1115 SUD waiver; no single public Medicaid SUD landing page was verified in-run (the direct hcpf.colorado.gov SUD path returned 404), so the field is null. HCPF's Special Connections page (hcpf.colorado.gov/special-connections, verified 200) covers Medicaid SUD treatment for pregnant and postpartum members only. Crisis: coloradocrisisservices.org now redirects to 988colorado.com; Colorado Crisis Services' long-published 1-844-493-8255 line remains in circulation, and 988 is Colorado's primary 24/7 lifeline per BHA.
